same_variant_rule: largest exposure F; then cohort, assay and rsid lexical ties; outcome independent
exposure_combination: one representative source per unique variant; no cross-platform exposure meta-analysis
missing_or_unstable_LD: freeze strongest exposure instrument only; never fill missing LD with zero
outcome_missing: use available members of the frozen set, record partial coverage, never substitute a rejected member
correlation_grid_role: stress tests, not estimated sample overlap or exhaustive uncertainty bounds
P_equivalent_role: SE=abs(logOR)/normal_isf(source_P/2), sensitivity only, not recovered source SE; undefined cases remain missing
